# R5.3 — Prepare execution, effect and Account amendment dossier

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/171_R5.3__adr-exec.md` (sequence 171 of 246) ·
**Base:** `codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.2` ·
**Requirement ids:** REQ-H-004 (primary), REQ-E-210 (contributing)

## Summary

GATE-G8's scoped authorization permits admission-dossier preparation only.
This ticket creates the **common seven-row §9.3 amendment register**
(`docs/build/planning/2026-10-30_amendment-dossier.md`) and authors the two
packets this ticket owns — launch/required grade/settlement (PADR-R5-1∗) and
effects/prepared calls/derived admission (PADR-R5-2∗) — with owner-bound
slots for the R5.4 (row 3) and R5.5 (rows 4–7) sibling packets that GATE-G9
(seq 174) will dispose. Nothing is admitted: no ADR number is allocated, no
product source/schema/generated file is touched, every proposed name is
marked `∗` unadmitted.

## Design decisions

- **One register file** over per-ticket dossiers: the seven-row register is
  the admission unit GATE-G9 reviews; slot rows + status column are the
  sibling-return audit (ADR-0384).
- **`∗` marking + PADR ids**: proposals stay citable without implying
  admission; no `docs/adr/` drafts (decided records only).
- **REQ-E-205 scoping**: the Dispatcher seam contract is prepared here; its
  §5/AC-5-2 operational cells are explicitly owed to P5 tickets (R5.32–34).
